title: HRLAIF: Improvements in Helpfulness and Harmlessness in Open-domain Reinforcement Learning From AI Feedback

bias_targets.target: Social bias and toxicity against minority groups
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's harmlessness using the ToxiGen dataset, which contains toxic prompts targeting various minority groups, and classifying the responses using a RoBERTa-based toxicity classifier.

Addressing the AI labeler's structural bias (favoring the first or second presented option) by evaluating each pair of responses twice with swapped positions, and computing the final preference based on the average score.
